title: Place: the universe
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a place name.

the universe

anchor.prefix: e flyleaf from the bottom to the top till he came to his own name. That was he: and he read down the page again. What was after the universe? Nothing. But was there anything round
anchor.suffix: to show where it stopped before the nothing place began? It could not be a wall but there could be a thin thin line there all round everything. It was very big to think about ever
